logp.method_description: Partition coefficient determination. Lipophilicity for R1 and R2 was determined by the “shake-flask” method using n-octanol/water phase partitions. Octanol-saturated water and water-saturated octanol were prepared using analytical grade n-octanol and double distilled water. The complexes R1 and R2 (1 mg/mL; ethanol/water 1/6) were diluted to 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 μg/mL in water and subsequently, these (1 mg/mL) were diluted to 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 μg/mL in n-octanol, respectively. Apt amounts of R1 and R2 (4 mg/mL) were shaken in equal amounts (50:50; v/v) for 24 h at room temperature. After achieving equilibrium, organic and aqueous phases were separated and centrifuged. The drug concentration in each phase was determined by UV/visible spectroscopy. Sample solution concentration was used to calculate log P and partition coefficient for R1 and R2 using the equation log P = log [Complex]octanol/[Complex]water.
